packet.headline_seed: Michael Jackson biopic smashes box office record
packet.description_seed: The film received poor reviews but has stormed the box office, taking $217m (£160m) globally.

what: Michael Jackson biopic smashes box office record

clean_source_blocks.text: The film received poor reviews but has stormed the box office, taking $217m (£160m) globally.

The Michael Jackson biopic Michael has shattered box office records, earning $217 million globally on its opening weekend. According to Variety, this makes it the biggest opening weekend ever for a biopic, surpassing Christopher Nolan's Oppenheimer which held the previous record with $174 million in 2023.
The new musical film about Michael Jackson has stormed the worldwide box office, scoring the highest opening weekend ever for a biopic.
The singer's nephew Jaafar Jackson portrays him in Michael, which has taken $217m (£160m) globally since it opened on Wednesday.
